claim_boundary: This result-informed engineering pilot evaluates one-step receding-horizon control after a frozen recovery candidate on the sole remaining known v12.6 outlier. Each cycle performs fresh policy inference, records the full-prefix risk, and advances only the exact first action after it passes the unchanged predictive gate. Advances occur only inside restored simulator-shadow lanes; no live policy action is dispatched and no task outcome is read. It is not qualification, task utility, deployment, or physical-safety evidence.
